'''Mohammad Mahmood Abubakar''' (born on 30 December 1958) is a Nigerian [[biologist]] and former [[Federal Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development|Agriculture]] and [[Federal Ministry of Environment (Nigeria)|Environment Minister]] of [[Nigeria]].

== Early life and education ==
Mohammad Mahmood Abubakar was born in Tudun Wada, Kaduna South of Kaduna State.<ref>{{Cite web |last=opeinfobase |date=2021-09-02 |title=Meet Mohammad Mahmood Abubakar The Ex-Minister Of Agriculture And Environment |url=https://infomediang.com/mohammad-mahmood-abubakar-biography/ |access-date=2023-09-09 |website=infomediang.com |language=en-us}}</ref>

He earned his bachelor's degree in biology with a concentration in microbiology from [[Central Washington University]] in [[Ellensburg, Washington]], his master's degree in resources management with a focus on natural resources management from the [[University of Arizona]] in [[Tucson]], and his doctorate in watershed management from the University of Arizona in Tucson, all in the United States.<ref name="auto">{{Cite web |title=Mohammad Mahmood Abubakar |url=https://www.weforum.org/people/mohammad-mahmood-abubakar/ |access-date=2023-09-09 |website=World Economic Forum |language=en}}</ref>

== Career ==
He worked as a microbiologist at the [[NNPC]] Kaduna Refinery in Kaduna when he was serving in the [[National Youth Service Corps|National Youth Service Corps (NYSC)]]. He worked at the [[Kittitas County, Washington|Kittitas County]] Health Department, University of Arizona, E&A Environmental Services [[Los Angeles, California]], Industrial Waste Investigator for the Municipality of Metropolitan Seattle, and Kittitas County (Health Dept.). He also held a position at the Directorate of Planning, Research, and Evaluation in Nigeria.<ref name="auto"/>
